report.status_line: Caution: Main water tank is empty, ATVs 3 and 5 fail to start, and water heater is non-functional.

concerns.title: Main water tank empty
concerns.detail: The engineering report indicates that the main water tank is empty, leaving the static tank at ¼.

concerns.title: ATVs 3 and 5 not starting
concerns.detail: ATVs 3 and 5 are not starting, which impacts vehicular mobility and field operations.

concerns.title: Water heater failure
concerns.detail: The water heater was checked by crew, but the water is still not heating up.

crew_actions: Troubleshoot ATVs 3 and 5, checking battery connections, spark plugs, and fuel levels.
Inspect the water heater electrical connections, thermostat, and heating elements.
Implement water conservation procedures while static water remains at ¼.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Approve or deny the morning EVA planned for Jan 13th 2015 by Rebeca, Renee, Wissam, and Romain.
decisions_for_earth.why: Off-habitat operations require Earth mission schedule authorization and safety review given vehicle issues.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Coordinate resupply delivery for habitat water and fuel resources as requested.
decisions_for_earth.why: The main water tank is reported empty and requires external logistics support.

report.message_to_earth: STATUS: Habitat status is caution due to an empty main water tank. WHAT HAPPENED: On 2015-01-12, the engineering report confirmed the main water tank is empty, with the static tank at ¼. WHAT THE CREW IS DOING: The crew is conserving water, checked the water heater, and inspected the vehicles. OTHER SYSTEMS: Diesel is at 75 percent and propane is at 45 percent, but ATVs 3 and 5 are not starting and the water heater is not heating. REQUEST: Earth approval is requested by tonight for the EVA planned for Rebeca, Renee, Wissam, and Romain on Jan 13th 2015. NEXT UPDATE: Next update will follow tomorrow evening.
